content.value_statement: Building reliable agent skills requires clear triggers, lean instructions, and useful resources. This skill gives a structured process for planning, writing, validating, packaging, and improving skills for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required SKILL.md structure, frontmatter, and bundled resource folders.
Guides planning of reusable scripts, references, and assets from concrete user examples.
Recommends concise, trigger-focused descriptions for automatic skill activation.
Describes validation and packaging steps for distributing a completed skill.
Provides an iteration workflow for improving skills after real use.
limitations: Does not include the referenced initialization or packaging scripts in this package.
Does not validate a skill automatically without external helper scripts.
Does not provide framework-specific templates beyond general examples.
Does not guarantee marketplace acceptance or security approval.

use_cases.title: Build a New Skill
use_cases.description: Create a focused skill folder with clear instructions and only necessary resources.

use_cases.title: Refine an Existing Skill
use_cases.description: Improve triggering, structure, and resource organization after users report weak performance.

use_cases.title: Package Skills for Sharing
use_cases.description: Prepare a skill for validation and distribution after the core instructions are complete.

prompt_templates.title: Create My First Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a new skill for [task]. Ask only the most important questions, then draft the SKILL.md plan.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Reusable Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these example requests and identify which scripts, references, or assets the skill should include.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill folder for trigger clarity, concise instructions, resource organization, and validation gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Forward Test a Complex Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a forward test for this skill using realistic tasks, minimal leaked context, and clear success criteria.

output_examples.input: I need a skill for editing PDFs.
output_examples.output: A skill plan with trigger description, required resources, validation steps, and suggested scripts for repeatable PDF tasks.

output_examples.input: My existing skill is too long and triggers poorly.
output: Specific references to move into separate files.
A revised description for better activation.

best_practices: Start with real user examples before writing reusable instructions.
Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed material into referenced files.
Test generated scripts and validate the finished skill before sharing.
anti_patterns: Creating broad skills that combine unrelated domains.
Adding README files, changelogs, or extra docs not required by the agent.
Shipping placeholder resource files after initialization.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create AI skills with clear triggers, lean instructions, and useful resources.

faq.question: Is it only for Claude?
faq.answer: No. The marketplace content supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code, although the source text focuses on Claude.

faq.question: Does it include helper scripts?
faq.answer: No. It references initialization, validation, and packaging scripts, but this package only contains SKILL.md.

faq.question: Can it update existing skills?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for revising instructions, resources, validation, and iteration workflows.

faq.question: Does it handle security review?
faq.answer: No. It guides skill creation, but authors must still review scripts, secrets, and external dependencies.

faq.question: When should I use references?
faq.answer: Use references for detailed knowledge that the agent should load only when needed.
